name: riverside
note: The Phase 3 locked world: the Phase 1 grid network and demand, the Phase 3 agent population and its declared street-avoidance policy. The three SUMO inputs are byte copies of PHASE_01/proof/sumo and are pinned by sha256; a world whose files do not match is refused.

agents.policy_note: AGENT POLICY, not a world fact. A closure bars one edge; an agent that perceives it also stays off the opposite direction of the same street. The twin edge is logged as avoided_by_policy, never as blocked.

drivers_reroute_note: Vehicles whose remaining route crosses a closed edge are re-routed by current travel time, as in the Phase 3 closure episode. false reproduces the Phase 3 agent episode, where they are not.

street_names.note: PRESENTATION ONLY. The network names junctions A0..D3; a narrator cannot say 'B1B2'. A column letter is an avenue, a row number is a street. The names carry no measurement.
